alt_text: Per-session distributions show mean heart rate, RMSSD, and SDNN by canonical cohort. Stress Index, SNS Index, and PNS Index are unavailable in source exports and have no plotted values.
interpretation: Episodic heart-rate and HRV distributions provide session autonomic context and remain distinct from WHOOP overnight recovery HRV.
limitations: Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.
long_description: Episodic heart-rate and HRV distributions provide session autonomic context and remain distinct from WHOOP overnight recovery HRV. Each dot is one available canonical episodic session; no missing value is estimated. n and missingness are reported separately for every metric and cohort. Wearables estimate physiologic, autonomic, MSK, movement, impact, and transport burden. They do not directly measure pain. Results are N-of-1 evidence, not clinical proof, diagnosis, causation, universal proof, or legal proof.

title: Available autonomic and heart-rate distributions
